52161.meaningLit: progress of the children of Manu
52161.notes: Ven. Sujato: Compare RV5,030.07c atrā dāsasya namuceḥ śiro yad avartayo manave gātum icchan. 'At the time when you caused the head of the Dāsa Namuci to roll, seeking an (open) way for Manu). The coincidence of topic and phrasing is too close for coincidence, and I propose that in this case, gāmiya is a taddhita from gama + iya. The phrase has the sense, 'the progress of the children of Manu', i.e. the Aryans.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sutaṃ te daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti?
na taṃ mātā pitā kayirā, aññe vā'pi ca ñātakā, sammāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, seyyaso naṃ tato kare.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhante, vacchassa taruṇassa mātaraṃ apassantassa siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo, evam'eva kho, bhante, sant'ettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhun'āgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ hantvā, rājāno dve ca khattiye, raṭṭhaṃ sānucaraṃ hantvā, anīgho yāti brāhmaṇo.
yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapako'va mātari.
mātari pitari c'āpi, atho jeṭṭhamhi bhātari. ācariye catutthamhi, tesu na mānaṃ kayirātha.

ehi tvaṃ, samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā nimiṃ rājānaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadehi, ayaṃ te, mahārāja, sahassayutto ājaññaratho sakkena devānam'indena pesito, abhiruheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṃ yānaṃ avikampamāno'ti.
panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.
sabrahmakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito

52180.meaning1: cared for by mother and father; treated with compassion by one's parents

examples.text: tam'enaṃ mātāpitaro sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīgham'āyuṃ pālehī'ti. mātāpit'ānukampitassa, mahānāma, kulaputtassa vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

52181.meaning1: performing one's parental duties; fulfilling filial responsibilities

examples.text: mātāpitukiccakaro, puttadārahito sadā, antojanassa atthāya, ye c'assa anujīvino.

52182.meaning1: protected by a mother and father
52182.commentary: (VIN) mātāpiturakkhitā nāma mātāpitaro rakkhanti gopenti issariyaṃ kārenti vasaṃ vattenti.

examples.text: yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

52183.grammar: masc, comp, dat pl of mātāpitar
52183.meaning1: for mothers and fathers; for parents

examples.text: brahmā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. pubb'ācariyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. pubbadevatā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. āhuneyyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

52184.meaning1: looking after one's parents; supporting one's mother and father
52184.commentary: (SNPa) idāni mātāpituupaṭṭhānan'ti ettha mātu ca pitu cā'ti mātāpitu. upaṭṭhānan'ti upaṭṭhahanaṃ.

examples.text: mātāpit'ūpaṭṭhānaṃ, puttadārassa saṅgaho, anākulā ca kamm'antā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

52186.meaning1: mother and son; mother and child

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ ubho mātāputtā vass'āvāsaṃ upagamiṃsu, bhikkhu ca bhikkhunī ca. te aññam'aññassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahesuṃ.
kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.

52188.meaning1: from parents; from mother and father

examples.text: cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummās'ūpacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

52189.meaning1: origination from one's parents; produced by one's mother and father

examples.text: gaṇḍo'ti kho, bhikkhave, imass'etaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.
cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummās'ūpacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

52190.meaning1: supporting one's mother and father; looking after one's parents

examples.text: kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.

52191.meaning1: one's mother before; previously one's mother

52192.commentary: (VINt) pitu mātā pitāmahī. mātu pitā mātāmaho. mātu mātā mātāmahī.

examples.text: atha naṃ ayaṃ te, tāta, mātāmaho, ayaṃ mātulo'ti vatvā vandāpesuṃ. so sabbe vandamāno vicaritvā ekam'pi attānaṃ vandantaṃ adisvā kiṃ nu kho maṃ vandantā n'atthī'ti pucchi.

52193.commentary: (VINt) pitu mātā pitāmahī. mātu pitā mātāmaho. mātu mātā mātāmahī.

examples.text: mattikan'ti mātito āgataṃ, idaṃ te mātāmahiyā mātu imaṃ gehaṃ āgacchantiyā gandhamāl'ādīnaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ dhanan'ti attho.
taṃ kissa hetu? mātito hi, bho gotama, anupapanno'ti.

52196.meaning1: name for an early stage of the Abhidhamma in the suttapiṭaka and vinayapiṭaka; (comm) two Pātimokkhas

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā. tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ

52197.commentary: (VINa) aṭṭhimā, bhikkhave, mātikā kathinassa ubbhārāya, pakkaman'antikā, niṭṭhānantikā, sanniṭṭhānantikā, nāsanantikā, savanantikā, āsāvacchedikā, sīm'ātikkantikā, sah'ubbhārā'ti

examples.text: ubbhatasmiṃ kathine'ti aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti, saṅghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.

52198.meaning1: water course; irrigation channel; water way; canal
52198.commentary: (ANa) na mātikāsampannan'ti na khuddakamahantīhi udakamātikāhi sampannaṃ hoti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, khettaṃ unnāmaninnāmi ca hoti, pāsāṇasakkharikañ'ca hoti, ūsarañ'ca hoti, na ca gambhīrasitaṃ hoti, na āyasampannaṃ hoti, na apāyasampannaṃ hoti, na mātikāsampannaṃ hoti, na mariyādasampannaṃ hoti.
